decisions.reason: The original Definition unconditionally assigns exact coefficients and an orthogonal projection to every evaluable real function, although its cited projection definition requires L2 membership. For uniform probability on [0,1], set u(0)=0 and u(y)=1/y for y>0, choose the admissible cutoff p=0 and Lambda={0}, and use one interior cubature node. The quadrature coefficient is finite but the exact constant coefficient integral diverges. This is a domain error, not a missing citation. Repaired by making only the exact-coefficient/projection sentence conditional on u representing an L2 class, preserving the estimator for all evaluable inputs.

reviews.reason: The finite weighted estimator remains defined by the supplied real node values, including empty index sets and signed or zero weights. Exact coefficients and the orthogonal projection are now invoked only for L2 inputs, where the existing projection supplier applies and Cauchy-Schwarz makes each coefficient integral finite. The added null-set caveat correctly distinguishes the quadrature input from its L2 equivalence class. No choice assumption, dependency, claimed accuracy, or estimator domain was added. This is review of my own repair, not independent acceptance. Inspected the owning page and all three direct item consumers; their uses remain sound. Refreshed exactly two full Definition quotations in the owning proof-contract file under the shared-write lock.
